memos.skeptic: Most likely loss: a bundle-driven distribution after the recent run. Bundle_share is 0.4472, so nearly half the curve came from coordinated wallets, and launch_bot_present is true with top5_buyer_share at 0.4494 in the first two minutes. Those buyers hold supply they can sell into the 30-min high. The last 15 minutes show sell_sol of 179 against buy_sol of 202, and sellers (84) are already a large share of buyers (235), with net flow only +22.8 SOL. That is distribution, not accumulation, and the 6% drawdown from the high may just be the start. Pool depth of 113 SOL is thin for a $20 ticket, so a 1.4-5.1% round trip is a real hurdle on any modest bounce. The skeptic's call is to skip.
